title: Sign EIP-1492
tagline: Token Protocol that Guarantees total ownership, relationship, authenticity and control with an experience revolutionary Social Network use case.
description:
We purposed the EIP-1492 where tokens are identified by hashes of their content and stored with this information into self-owned non-transferible smart contracts that interacts only within the protocol compliance smart contracts.

This is purposed to become a better standard than NFTs and other existing data tokens because we solve many space problems, including but not limited to: 
-Guarantees of the total ownership not subjet to third party contracts.
-Verifiable directional relationship with the content.
-Authenticity of the asset.
-Capability to build over it to construct consensus protocols.
-Avoid hacking, robbery and many other current problems.

To show some IRL use we developed a new social network experience that will blow everyone's mind!, using things, signatures and behaviors to access the content making it available IRL and also in Metaverses, a full sensorial 720º solution.
how_its_made:
We developed the architecture of the standard EI`P-1492 and contruct the PoC contracts using the basis:
-Direct identification for tokens.
-Possibility to send and receive tokens (real owner transfer from contract to contrac).
-Non transferible contracts.

Then we made the dApps to use it so we have a PoC demo site that let you mint, see and transfer a token, including some great filters using sponsors technology.

Then we analyzed Social Network use case and mada cellphone App that follows the protocol and let you interact with the purposed use case of signs (aka FCS tokens).
